SEARCH
Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.math

Class UGraphicTeXGraphics

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.math.UGraphicTeXGraphics
All Implemented Interfaces:
TeXGraphics
public class UGraphicTeXGraphics extends Object implements TeXGraphics
The canvas of JLaTeXMath (see PLAN.md, phase 2) drawn on a UGraphic: a formula is only paths, so that every output (SVG, PNG, PDF, EMF, the C build...) gets it the same way, with no font and no Batik.

UGraphic only knows translations, so this class keeps its own affine transformation (scale, rotate, translate of the boxes) and gives the shapes to the UGraphic with their points already transformed. A glyph is a filled path made from glyphs.bin, a line is a stroked path.

The origin of the formula is the origin of the UGraphic given to the constructor.

The color of the formula is an HColor, given as is to the UGraphic (which applies its color mapper, as for any shape). A color set by the boxes (an AWT color, from \color) replaces it until it is set back.

    • drawText

      public void drawText(String text, double fontSize)
      Description copied from interface: TeXGraphics
      Draws text that no TeX font has the glyphs of (see TeXTextMeasurer), with its baseline origin at the current origin. The font size is in the current units, as the size of the glyphs of TeXGraphics.drawChar(int, char) is. The canvas may not rotate or flip it.
